text.text_excerpt: It was a nice experience from start to finish. When we got the we were greeted by the young lady at the front desk (Breeon). She was very professional, friendly and informative throughtout our whole stay. We asked another woman at the front desk for info but she didn't seem to know much. The room was comfortable a bit smaller than what we were used to but it was cool. The only complaint we have is that the bathroom didn't have a vent so the room retained smells. We just ended up buying air freshener. House keeping was pretty good with keeping everything cleaned. The restaurant downstairs was awesome! The food was good and they were very knowledgeable about the city and recommended a coupl...

I had a good experience at this hotel. I stayed for a week and was placed in a top floor suite! I was so excited at how big my room was (I booked through a travel agent which might be why I got a nice room). The wi-fi was quick and convenient, I had a refrigerator and microwave that worked well. The hotel was fairly quiet, even on a night when there was a music festival going on at Lafayette Square. I liked my stay there, I would stay again.

Very good hotel to stay at. Great location and really nice room. They always had water in the lobby and had food in the afternoon which was really nice. Only complaint was the hot water heater took a little while to turn on at times. Besides that I would definitely stay there again.
